metric_definitions.isolated_false_positive_rate: Unique alerted benign events / labeled benign events
metric_definitions.correlation_false_positive_rate: Benign workflows with a false incident / labeled benign workflows
metric_definitions.legacy_f1: Legacy mixed alert/incident precision and scenario recall; use workflow_metrics for consistent-unit F1

provenance.limitations: Synthetic workflows are correlated and generated from known patterns. Wilson intervals describe sample uncertainty only; they do not establish external validity.
